currentContext.expansion: The Company's stated expansion is entirely inorganic and still pending shareholder approval at the 43rd AGM (September 21, 2026). The Board approved the acquisition of 100% of the shareholding of SVR Electro Projects Private Limited, to be effected by acquiring 30,00,000 equity shares of SVR from its shareholders for consideration other than cash, by issuing up to 1,45,41,000 equity shares of the Company at a swap ratio of 4.847:1; on completion SVR becomes a wholly owned subsidiary. The Board describes the acquisition as aligned with a long-term strategy of expanding into the renewable energy and railway infrastructure sectors, and expects it to strengthen execution capability, diversify revenue streams, expand the order book, and improve the ability to bid for larger tenders from Central and State Government agencies, public sector undertakings, Indian Railways and metro rail corporations. SVR itself is described as executing electrical infrastructure, railway, renewable energy, solar EPC, O&M and Battery Energy Storage System projects, having entered the solar renewable energy sector during FY 2025-26 under programmes such as MAHAGENCO and MSEDCL, and having been awarded a 25 MW / 50 MWh standalone BESS project at Gajuwaka, Andhra Pradesh for APTRANSCO. Separately, and earlier in the year, shareholders at the EGM of May 16, 2025 altered the object clause to permit activities in the FMCG and Power sectors, and the Company surrendered its NBFC registration with RBI approval dated January 23, 2026. To fund future activity the Board is seeking approval to raise the borrowing limit to Rs. 400 Crores standalone and Rs. 900 Crores including subsidiaries and associates, expressly including for meeting capital expenditure. No capacity, plant or rupee capex quantum is disclosed for the Company itself.
